title: Flux's Improved Wolves
description: A Simple Datapack that Improves Wolves with new Features and Better AI that is based on a video
body:
# Flux's Improved Wolves
![wolves](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ae9c4727e57a78e54b297714233832c7ed361171_0.webp)

The **Flux's Improved Wolves Datapack** is a simple datapack that is designed to improve Wolves AI and adding new features to make Wolves just better overall. By [JFlux](https://www.youtube.com/@FluxDoesYT)

The Features are based on this Short made on [Youtube](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/If1D5zEyA8o)/[Tiktok](https://www.tiktok.com/@fluxdoesyt/video/7616270207677484308)
Feel free to check them out

_Also this is my first time publishing my work here so expect bugs or inconsistency_

**Config Command:**```/function wolf:config```

Each of the Features can be turned on or off 

![Config](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a1ba460b3134563354f6c69c61923ea3d071dab9.gif)


<details>
<summary>Features 🐺</summary>

**Creeper Dodge** - Makes Wolves able to dodge Creeper Explosion and avoid them (with a cooldown).

**Safety Net** - Teleport Wolves back to their Owner if there is Lava/Magma/Void (with a cooldown) (Only teleports if the Owner is in a safe block too).

**Calmable Wolves** - Crouch to calm down your wolf when they are attacking to prevent any Unwanted Kill.

**Fetching** - Allows wolves to fetch Arrows after the battle is finished (Spectral Arrows Work, Not Compatible With Infinity).

**Barking Danger** - Warns and glows hostile mobs that tries to sneak behind you and instantly attack them (with a cooldown).

**Campfire Regen** - Allows Wolves to gain Regeneration when sitting near Campfires.

_Images/Gifs are Shown in the Gallery Tab to see what they look like_

</details>

## 📌Requirements
- Minecraft 1.21.11 - 26.1.1
- Since its a datapack, you can use it in both plugin servers (Paper/Bukkit) or mods servers (Fabric/Forge/NeoForge)
- Minecraft Java
- A Device

## ⚠️Incompatibility
- Any Version Below 1.21.11 (because Minecraft did a huge command syntax rework there and any version below it will most likely not run anything)

If there are any bugs 🐛 or suggestions 💡, feel free to contact me through the comments of those videos mentioned
